# Roots & Leaves

> South India's premium herbal hair wellness brand

Roots & Leaves is a premium botanical wellness company rooted in the ancient Ayurvedic hair care traditions of South India. We specialize in 100% natural, chemical-free herbal hair oils, shampoos, conditioners, hair dyes, and bath powders.

## Brand Identity
- **Founded**: 2022
- **Headquarters**: 10-1-62, Chaitanya Nagar, Gajuwaka, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 530026, India
- **Core Philosophy**: Complete transparency, pure botanical efficacy, and the preservation of sacred South Indian hair care rituals.
- **Regions Served**: Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and all of India.

## Key Products
- **Herbal Hair Oil**: Handcrafted with Ayurvedic botanicals like Bhringraj, Amla, and Hibiscus to stimulate growth and reduce hair fall.
- **Natural Shampoo**: Chemical-free, sulfate-free cleansers made with traditional Reetha and Shikakai.
- **Herbal Hair Dye**: Plant-based, gentle alternative to synthetic dyes.
- **Bath Powders**: Traditional skin-nourishing botanical blends.

## Product Quality
- 100% Natural Ingredients
- Zero Synthetic Chemicals
- No Parabens or Sulfates
- Handcrafted in Small Batches
